# Coordinator contract fixtures

`canonicalization.json` and `entry-key.json` are vendored, byte-for-byte
copies of the frozen contract fixtures from the coordinator repository
(`ShowMeshSystems/showmesh`, `test/fixtures/fpp/`). They are not generated by
this repository and must not be hand-edited here: they are pasted literals
produced once by the coordinator's Go reference implementation
(`pkg/fppidentity`), the same way that repository's own README describes.

They exist here so `coordinator_fixtures_test.cpp` can prove, on every
`make -C native test` run, that this plugin's C++ canonicalization and
entry-key derivation (`native/src/json.cpp`,
`native/src/playlist_identity.cpp`) still agree byte for byte with the
coordinator's independent implementation. Before this test existed, only the
coordinator side ran these fixtures; this plugin had no pinned expected
value anywhere.

See the coordinator repository's `test/fixtures/fpp/README.md` for the file
format and case list, and
`docs/build/FPP-PLUGIN-COORDINATOR-CONTRACTS.md` section 4 for why the two
independent implementations must agree.

`ingestion.json` from the coordinator's fixture set is deliberately not
vendored here: it exercises the coordinator's own HTTP handler, which this
repository has no server of that shape to test against.

## Regenerating

Do not hand-edit these files to make a failing case pass. If a case
disagrees with this repository's implementation, that is a contract
disagreement to raise against both repositories (see the coordinator
README's "Regenerating after a deliberate contract change" section), never
a unilateral edit to whichever fixture value is inconvenient on one side.
When the coordinator repository regenerates these files for a reviewed
contract change, re-copy both files here from the coordinator repository's
`test/fixtures/fpp/` verbatim.
